notes.title: "WarOS" Early Access Version 0.9.1 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear commanders :



To continuously optimize the interstellar combat experience, "WarOS" has now released the early access version 0.9.1 update. This update focuses on the iteration of core functions and the refinement of details. The following are the specific contents:



\[Core Update Content]  

1. Optimized some special effects effects.

2. Optimized the task related content of some levels.

3. Optimized some of the classical Chinese content in the settings menu.

4. Optimized the ability to click with the mouse to use some resource props, manufacture vehicles, build buildings, and mount objects.

5. Optimized the merging of the public prop bar into the local prop bar.

6. Optimized vehicle pathfinding collision.

7. Optimized the initial available levels for some buildings.

8. Added a detailed modification interface and optimized the UI for enhancing prompts such as vehicle upgrade status.

9. Increased the situation where crew members are unable to continue working after being injured.

10. Add the function of holding down the Alt key to display the health bar.

11. Add content related to various new armored platforms and a small defense tower.

12. Enhance the 3D perspective display effect.



\[Feedback Channel]

If you encounter any abnormalities or have optimization suggestions during your experience, please feel free to email us（ hitfbi@hotmail.com ）Feedback. Every suggestion will become an important coordinate for optimizing the interstellar journey! 



\[Commander's Message]

May the new version of Star River Battlefield allow you to experience a more immersive strategic charm when deploying fleets and laying out galaxies. Next stop in the universe, let's explore together!

notes.title: "War On Space": Early Access Version 0.9.0.5 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders:

To continuously optimize the interstellar combat experience, 《Star Wars WarOS》has now released the Early Access Version 0.9.0.5 update. This update focuses on core feature iterations and detail refinement. Below are the specific details:


【Core Update Content】

  1. Optimized certain levels (balance and mission-related content).  
  2. Added a rear-view camera function for vehicles (press the spacebar to enable; once enabled, use the right mouse button to continuously fire advanced ammunition).  
  3. Optimized ship pathfinding functionality.  
  4. Enhanced scene rendering effects and special effects.  
  5. Added an opening video.  
  6. Fixed several bugs.


【Feedback Channels】  
If you encounter any issues or have optimization suggestions during your experience, please feel free to provide feedback through the official community (QQ Group: 894861758). Every suggestion will become an important milestone in optimizing Star Trek!  

【Commander's Message】  
May the new version of the starfield battlefield allow you to feel the immersive strategic charm when deploying fleets and planning galactic layouts. The next stop in the universe—let's explore together!

notes.title: The official version of "WarOS" is about to be released, remove the demo version
notes.notes:
Dear players:



After a long period of careful polishing and unremitting efforts by our team, the highly anticipated official version of "War On Space" will be officially launched on the Steam platform in the near future! The official version, based on the demo version, has complete game content and new optimized designs such as interface and operation. We believe it will bring everyone a richer, more exciting, and smoother gaming experience. ​

With the arrival of the official version, the demo version has completed its phased mission and we have taken it down.

We have always been very grateful for everyone's support and love for 'War On Space'. Whether it is the valuable feedback given during the demo testing phase or the anticipation for the official version, it has given us great motivation. We hope that after the official version is launched, everyone can fully enjoy the fun brought by the game. We also welcome everyone to continue to provide us with feedback and suggestions on the game, and help us make the game better!





\[The 7 Studio]

\[2025.7.22]

notes.title: WarOS Early Access Version 0.9.0.1 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders:

﻿

In order to further optimise the gaming experience, we are pleased to announce the release of the Early Access Version 0.9.0.1 update. This update will bring several core feature upgrades and gameplay optimisations, as detailed below:

﻿

1. Added customisable control buttons for the main camera;

﻿

2. Optimised level experience, shortened level duration, and reduced difficulty;

﻿

3. Added scheduled production mode to the printer module;

﻿

4. Increased ground vehicle movement speed;

﻿

5. Comprehensively optimised level balance, adjusted turret base attributes, and adapted to the overall gameplay rhythm.

﻿

If you encounter any issues during gameplay or have valuable suggestions for the game, please feel free to provide feedback in the comment section. Every piece of feedback you provide will help WarOS embark on an even more perfect interstellar journey! May you enjoy the thrill of strategic planning and decisive victories in every battle across the vast cosmos!

notes.title: WarOS Trial Version 0.8.8.8 Update Announcement
WarOS Trial 0.8.8.6 Update Notice
The trial version of WarOS is now open for download at the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Star Commanders, the moment you've been waiting for has finally arrived! The trial version of WarOS is now available for download at the Steam New Products Festival, inviting you to step into this intergalactic battlefield full of unknowns and challenges!
The demo has a lot of content for you:
Immersive Battlefield Experience: Step into a well-designed starfield with unique terrain, different resource distribution, and hostile forces. Every corner may hide opportunities and crises, allowing you to immerse yourself in an intense and exciting atmosphere of intergalactic warfare.
Free troop formation: more than ten kinds of armed equipment for your free deployment. From powerful energy weapons to durable defense shields, each type of equipment is equipped with unique weapon systems and defense mechanisms. Mix and match freely to create an unstoppable ace troop and show your strategy and creativity.
In-depth battle experience: simple and easy to understand the operation, so you can quickly get started, and put more energy into the ever-changing battlefield situation. Exciting battle process, mysterious and unpredictable battlefield variables, always test your command strategy. Standing out in the battle, you will have a chance to unlock the hidden weapons and equipment upgrade module, adding powerful help for your troops.

If you find any problems or have any suggestions, please feel free to give us your feedback in the following ways:
Discord Link：https://discord.gg/MmqtPRGpGA, in the group directly to the administrator feedback.
Steam Community: Post on the “Trial Feedback” board of the WarOS Steam Community Forum.

We look forward to your valuable opinions and work together to make WarOS an even more exciting intergalactic game! What are you waiting for? Go to the Steam New Product Festival to download the demo and start your intergalactic adventure!
[WarOS Dev Team]
[February 24, 2025]
